scope: Apparatus and measurement diagrams beside practical methods; shared artwork reused in the practical-skills chapter.

placements.heading: Microscopy and biological drawings
placements.purpose: A coverslip is lowered at an angle onto a thin stained specimen on a glass slide, using a mounted needle.

placements.heading: Antibiotics and antiseptics on agar
placements.purpose: Equal-sized antimicrobial discs sit on an inoculated agar plate. Clear zones differ in diameter; a solvent-only control has no clear zone.

placements.heading: Osmosis in plant tissue
placements.purpose: Equal-sized potato cylinders are immersed in equal volumes of different concentrations, then blotted and reweighed.

placements.heading: Food tests
placements.purpose: Positive food-test results: reducing sugar gives a coloured Benedict’s precipitate after warming, starch blue-black iodine, protein purple Biuret and lipid a Sudan-stained oil layer.

placements.heading: Amylase and pH
placements.purpose: Starch, amylase and buffer react in a controlled water bath. Fresh samples go into separate iodine wells every thirty seconds until starch is no longer detected.

placements.heading: Human reaction time
placements.purpose: The ruler starts with zero level with the participant’s open thumb and finger. Record fall distance when caught and convert it to reaction time.

placements.heading: Seedling responses to light or gravity
placements.purpose: Comparable seedlings receive one-sided or all-round light. The shoot bends towards one-sided light; record lengths and labelled drawings.

placements.heading: Ecology sampling
placements.purpose: Quadrats placed at regular distances along a transect sample an environmental gradient. Record abundance and the environmental factor at each site.

placements.heading: Ecology sampling
placements.purpose: Random coordinates locate equal-sized quadrats across the habitat to estimate a population.

placements.heading: Milk decay and temperature
placements.purpose: Milk, sodium carbonate and indicator equilibrate in a controlled water bath before lipase is added. Measure time to the same pH endpoint.

verification: Reviewed against the locally retained AQA specification and the adjacent method.
SVG labels checked for overlap and clipping; apparatus drawings visually inspected.
Affected reading groups checked at 1366, 390 and 320 px; diagrams load with no page overflow.
